response.description: Final answer produced by the agent.

sessionId.description: Conversation ID used to scope this session.

resumedSession.description: Whether this turn resumed an existing session.

cacheHit.description: Whether the response was served from cache.

conversationSummary.description: Brief summary of what the agent did.

requiresInput.description: Whether execution paused waiting for user input.

elicitationSchema.description: MCP form schema expected for an elicitation response.

elicitationToolName.description: Paused MCP tool requesting the input.

permissionRequestId.description: Immutable identifier that must be echoed when approving or denying a tool call.

permissionServerName.description: MCP server owning the permission-gated tool.

permissionArguments.description: Exact proposed arguments for the permission-gated tool call.

permissionExpiresAtEpochMs.description: Epoch-millisecond deadline for the active permission request; null means no expiration.

responseSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the structured response expected for the active input request.

traceReportPath.description: Relative path to the live HTML trace report.

toolCalls.description: Ordered list of tool calls made during execution.

uiResourceUri.description: URI of the MCP-UI resource returned by this tool (e.g. ui://...), if any.

uiHtml.description: Rendered HTML of the MCP-UI resource associated with this tool call, if any.
